results.question: What is the average salary of employees per branch?
results.sql:
SELECT
  l.name AS branch_name,
  AVG(e.salary) AS average_salary
FROM employees AS e
JOIN locations AS l
  ON e.location_id = l.id
GROUP BY
  l.name
ORDER BY
  l.name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT l.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id GROUP BY l.name

results.question: How many vehicles are there in each category?
results.sql:
SELECT
  vc.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(v.id) AS vehicle_count
FROM vehicle_categories AS vc
LEFT JOIN vehicles AS v
  ON vc.id = v.category_id
GROUP BY
  vc.name
ORDER BY
  vc.name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_categories c ON v.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

results.question: What is the total revenue from completed payments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed';
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed'

results.question: Show total revenue by location.
results.sql:
SELECT
  l.name AS location_name,
  SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM payments AS p
JOIN reservations AS r
  ON p.reservation_id = r.id
JOIN locations AS l
  ON r.pickup_location = l.id
GROUP BY
  l.id,
  l.name
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC;
results.gold_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN reservations r ON p.reservation_id = r.id JOIN locations l ON r.pickup_location = l.id GROUP BY l.name

results.question: What is the average rating for each vehicle category?
results.sql:
SELECT
  vc.name AS category_name,
  AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM vehicle_categories AS vc
JOIN vehicles AS v
  ON vc.id = v.category_id
JOIN reservations AS res
  ON v.id = res.vehicle_id
JOIN reviews AS r
  ON res.id = r.reservation_id
GROUP BY
  vc.name
ORDER BY
  vc.name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(rv.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews rv JOIN reservations r ON rv.reservation_id = r.id JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id JOIN vehicle_categories c ON v.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

results.question: Which vehicle categories have more than fifteen vehicles? Show the category name and the count.
results.sql:
SELECT
  vc.name,
  COUNT(v.id) AS vehicle_count
FROM vehicle_categories AS vc
JOIN vehicles AS v
  ON vc.id = v.category_id
GROUP BY
  vc.name
HAVING
  COUNT(v.id) > 15;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_categories c ON v.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 15

results.question: How much have we spent on maintenance per maintenance type?
results.sql:
SELECT
  maintenance_type,
  SUM(cost) AS total_spent
FROM maintenance_records
GROUP BY
  maintenance_type
ORDER BY
  total_spent DESC;
results.gold_sql: SELECT maintenance_type, SUM(cost) AS total FROM maintenance_records GROUP BY maintenance_type

results.question: Care este veniturile totale pe fiecare metodă de plată?
results.sql:
SELECT

  SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM payments
WHERE

results.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method

results.question: List the reservations picked up in Miami. Show reservation id, pickup date and return date.
results.sql:
SELECT
  r.id AS reservation_id,
  r.pickup_date,
  r.return_date
FROM reservations AS r
JOIN locations AS l
  ON r.pickup_location = l.id
WHERE
  l.city = 'Miami';
results.gold_sql: SELECT r.id, r.pickup_date, r.return_date FROM reservations r JOIN locations l ON r.pickup_location = l.id WHERE l.city = 'Miami'

results.question: Show each client's first name, last name and the number of reservations they made, including clients with none.
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  COUNT(r.id) AS number_of_reservations
FROM clients AS c
LEFT JOIN reservations AS r
  ON c.id = r.client_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name
ORDER BY
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.id) AS reservations FROM clients c LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name

results.question: Which employees work at the Downtown Hub? Show first name, last name and role.

FROM employees AS e
JOIN locations AS l

results.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.role FROM employees e JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Downtown Hub'

results.question: Which reservations have no payment recorded against them? Show reservation id, pickup date and total cost.
results.sql:
SELECT
  r.id,
  r.pickup_date,
  r.total_cost
FROM reservations AS r
LEFT JOIN payments AS p
  ON r.id = p.reservation_id
WHERE
  p.id IS NULL;
results.gold_sql: SELECT r.id, r.pickup_date, r.total_cost FROM reservations r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.reservation_id = r.id)

results.question: Show all reviews with a rating of 1. Show the rating, the comment, and the make and model of the vehicle.
results.sql:
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.comment,
  v.make,
  v.model
FROM reviews AS r
JOIN reservations AS res
  ON r.reservation_id = res.id
JOIN vehicles AS v
  ON res.vehicle_id = v.id
WHERE
  r.rating = 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT rv.rating, rv.comment, v.make, v.model FROM reviews rv JOIN reservations r ON rv.reservation_id = r.id JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE rv.rating = 1

results.question: Which vehicles have a daily rate above the average daily rate? Show make, model and daily rate.
results.sql:
SELECT
  make,
  model,
  daily_rate
FROM vehicles
WHERE
  daily_rate > (
    SELECT
      AVG(daily_rate)
    FROM vehicles
  );
results.gold_sql: SELECT make, model, daily_rate FROM vehicles WHERE daily_rate > (SELECT AVG(daily_rate) FROM vehicles)

results.question: Which clients spent the most money in total? Show the top ten as first name, last name and total spent.
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM clients AS c
JOIN reservations AS r
  ON c.id = r.client_id
JOIN payments AS p
  ON r.id = p.reservation_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name
ORDER BY
  total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(r.total_cost) AS spent FROM clients c JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

results.question: Find the branch with the highest total revenue. Show the branch name and its total revenue.
results.sql:
SELECT
  l.name AS branch_name,
  SUM(r.total_cost) AS total_revenue
FROM locations AS l
JOIN reservations AS r
  ON l.id = r.pickup_location
WHERE
  r.status IN ('completed', 'active')
GROUP BY
  l.name
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN reservations r ON p.reservation_id = r.id JOIN locations l ON r.pickup_location = l.id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which vehicles have had more than three maintenance records? Show make, model and license plate.
results.sql:
SELECT
  v.make,
  v.model,
  v.license_plate
FROM vehicles AS v
JOIN maintenance_records AS mr
  ON v.id = mr.vehicle_id
GROUP BY
  v.id,
  v.make,
  v.model,
  v.license_plate
HAVING
  COUNT(mr.id) > 3;
results.gold_sql: SELECT v.make, v.model, v.license_plate FROM vehicles v WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_records m WHERE m.vehicle_id = v.id) > 3

results.question: List clients who have never left a review. Show first and last name.
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name
FROM clients AS c
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM reservations AS r
    JOIN reviews AS rv
      ON r.id = rv.reservation_id
    WHERE
      r.client_id = c.id
  );
results.gold_sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM clients c WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM reservations r
  JOIN reviews rv ON rv.reservation_id = r.id
  WHERE r.client_id = c.id
)

results.question: For each branch, show the highest paid employee as branch name, first name, last name and salary.
results.sql:
SELECT
  l.name AS branch_name,
  e.first_name,
  e.last_name,
  e.salary
FROM employees AS e
JOIN locations AS l
  ON e.location_id = l.id
WHERE
  (e.location_id, e.salary) IN (
    SELECT
      location_id,
      MAX(salary)
    FROM employees
    GROUP BY
      location_id
  );
results.gold_sql:
SELECT name, first_name, last_name, salary FROM (
  SELECT l.name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS rn
  FROM employees e JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id
) t WHERE rn = 1

results.question: Show monthly reservation counts for 2024, as the first day of each month and the count.
results.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_date) AS month_start,
  COUNT(id) AS reservation_count
FROM reservations
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pickup_date) = 2024
GROUP BY
  month_start
ORDER BY
  month_start;
results.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations WHERE pickup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND pickup_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.question: Care sunt cei mai buni clienți?

  SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM clients AS c

results.question: Show me the good vehicles.
results.sql:
SELECT
  v.id,
  v.make,
  v.model,
  v.year,
  v.license_plate,
  v.daily_rate,
  AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM vehicles AS v
JOIN reservations AS res
  ON v.id = res.vehicle_id
JOIN reviews AS r
  ON res.id = r.reservation_id
GROUP BY
  v.id,
  v.make,
  v.model,
  v.year,
  v.license_plate,
  v.daily_rate
HAVING
  AVG(r.rating) >= 4 -- Defining "good" as having an average rating of 4 or higher
ORDER BY
  average_rating DESC,
  v.make,
  v.model;

results.question: How is the business doing?
results.sql:
WITH ReservationStats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(id) AS total_reservations,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN id END) AS completed_reservations,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN id END) AS active_reservations,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN id END) AS cancelled_reservations,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_cost ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue_from_completed_reservations,
        AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN (return_date - pickup_date) END) AS average_rental_duration_days
    FROM reservations
),
PaymentStats AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_payments_received
    FROM payments
),
MaintenanceStats AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(cost) AS total_maintenance_cost
    FROM maintenance_records
),
VehicleStats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(id) AS total_vehicles,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'available' THEN id END) AS vehicles_available,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'rented' THEN id END) AS vehicles_rented,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'maintenance' THEN id END) AS vehicles_in_maintenance,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'retired' THEN id END) AS vehicles_retired
    FROM vehicles
),
ReviewStats AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(rating) AS average_review_rating
    FROM reviews
),
EmployeeStats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(id) AS total_employees
    FROM employees
),
LocationStats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(id) AS total_locations
    FROM locations
),
ClientStats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(id) AS total_clients
    FROM clients
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(rs.total_reservations, 0) AS total_reservations_count,
    COALESCE(rs.completed_reservations, 0) AS completed_reservations_count,
    COALESCE(rs.active_reservations, 0) AS active_reservations_count,
    COALESCE(rs.cancelled_reservations, 0) AS cancelled_reservations_count,
    COALESCE(rs.total_revenue_from_completed_reservations, 0.00) AS total_revenue_from_completed_reservations,
    COALESCE(rs.average_rental_duration_days, 0.0) AS average_rental_duration_days,
    COALESCE(ps.total_payments_received, 0.00) AS total_payments_received,
    COALESCE(ms.total_maintenance_cost, 0.00) AS total_maintenance_cost,
    COALESCE(vs.total_vehicles, 0) AS total_vehicles_count,
    COALESCE(vs.vehicles_available, 0) AS vehicles_available_count,
    COALESCE(vs.vehicles_rented, 0) AS vehicles_rented_count,
    COALESCE(vs.vehicles_in_maintenance, 0) AS vehicles_in_maintenance_count,
    COALESCE(vs.vehicles_retired, 0) AS vehicles_retired_count,
    COALESCE(rss.average_review_rating, 0.0) AS average_review_rating,
    COALESCE(es.total_employees, 0) AS total_employees_count,
    COALESCE(ls.total_locations, 0) AS total_locations_count,
    COALESCE(cs.total_clients, 0) AS total_clients_count
FROM
    ReservationStats rs,
    PaymentStats ps,
    MaintenanceStats ms,
    VehicleStats vs,
    ReviewStats rss,
    EmployeeStats es,
    LocationStats ls,
    ClientStats cs;
